headline: FREEPORT PAYS C$110M FOR 51% OF TDG AURORA WEST — WORLD'S BIGGEST COPPER PRODUCER ENTERS BC'S TOODOGGONE DISTRICT
snippet: Freeport-McMoRan Mineral Properties Canada Inc. — a subsidiary of the world's largest publicly traded copper producer — agreed November 12 to acquire a 51% joint-venture interest in TDG Gold Corp.'s (TSXV:TDG) Aurora West copper-gold porphyry project in BC's Toodoggone District for C$110 million in cash, with Freeport also committed to fund C$30 million in exploration expenditures within three years of closing. TDG retains 49% of Aurora West and keeps its separate Shasta and Baker gold projects outside the deal; additional earn-in rights tied to further spending milestones give Freeport a path to a larger stake. The entry of the world's leading copper miner into what had been a junior-dominated BC district validates the Toodoggone corridor's tier-1 porphyry potential and fundamentally reshapes the risk profile for TSX-V explorers working in adjacent ground.

headline: METAL ENERGY FIRST NIV DRILLING CONFIRMS LARGE TOODOGGONE PORPHYRY — 426m @ 0.17% CuEq IN INAUGURAL HOLE; STRONGER GRADES NORTH
snippet: Metal Energy Corp.'s (OTC:MEEEF) inaugural drilling at the NIV copper-gold porphyry project in BC's Toodoggone District returned 426.0 metres grading 0.17% copper-equivalent in hole NIV26-011 — the first-ever drill test of the property — confirming a large-scale bulk-tonnage porphyry system in a district that attracted C$110 million from Freeport-McMoRan the same week. The company reports stronger grades to the north of NIV26-011, suggesting the first hole tested the southern margin of a larger system. Metal Energy's strategic shareholders include Centerra Gold and Teck Resources, each holding 9.9%. The timing of these results — arriving as Freeport validates Toodoggone with C$110 million — positions NIV as one of the most timely district-scale porphyry discoveries in BC this year.
